# IH-Tech

> A team of AI experts that join yours. Technical advisory, embedded delivery, team enablement, and agent architectures for teams in the EU, North America, and the Middle East.

IH-Tech is a team of AI experts in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Contact: info@ihtech.ba

- **Technical advisory**: We take the senior seat on decisions that are expensive to get wrong: feasibility, architecture, and sequencing. Your team leaves with an answer it can act on.
- **Embedded teams**: AI experts join your program and work in your backlog, to your standards. They have done the hard version before, and they are accountable for shipped work.
- **Team enablement**: The aim is for your engineers to do this work without us. We run the workshops, set the standards, and put in the evaluation practice that makes AI-assisted delivery measurable.
- **Agentic products**: We design agent systems with separate planning, implementation, and review roles, connected to the systems a business already runs. Discovery runs in days.
- **Platforms and tooling**: The biggest gain is often a tool nobody has built yet: migration tooling, evaluation platforms, and internal assistants connected to systems a company already pays for.

- [Modernizing legacy systems with AI agents](https://ihtech.ba/field-guides/agentic-legacy-modernization/): A control-loop strategy for AI-agent modernization: structure first, plans as reviewed prompts, machine-generated parity evidence, and a clear fit test.

## AI agents

Ten AI agents for internal business processes. They run with their AI models inside the client’s infrastructure; no outside AI service is called.

- [Private AI agents inside your infrastructure](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/): Ten AI agents for banks, healthcare and the public sector, configured to your needs and run inside your infrastructure. Nothing leaves your network.
- [Customer Desk AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/customer-desk-ai-agent/): Customer Desk AI Agent answers routine customer questions in seconds and routes the rest, so your support team handles more with the same people.
- [Document AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/document-ai-agent/): Document AI Agent checks contracts against your own rules, flags every renewal before its notice date and moves documents through approval in your company.
- [System Guardian AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/system-guardian-ai-agent/): System Guardian AI Agent groups alerts into incidents, finds the likely cause and runs only the fixes you approved, so your IT team is woken less often.
- [Task AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/task-ai-agent/): Task AI Agent turns requests from chat and email into tasks with an owner and a due date, follows up on overdue work and reports progress to every team.
- [Sales AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/sales-ai-agent/): Sales AI Agent prepares every meeting, drafts quotes from your own price lists and keeps the CRM current, so each rep gets five hours a week back for selling.
- [Knowledge Guide AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/knowledge-guide-ai-agent/): Knowledge Guide AI Agent answers employees’ questions from your intranet, policies and documents, with the source, so HR and IT get 40% fewer questions.
- [People AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/people-ai-agent/): People AI Agent answers HR questions from your own records and runs onboarding and leave requests, halving routine requests to HR while managers decide.
- [Finance AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/finance-ai-agent/): Finance AI Agent matches invoices to orders and deliveries, checks spend against policy and shortens month-end close, so your finance team pays on time.
- [Meeting AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/meeting-ai-agent/): Meeting AI Agent finds the time and the room, prepares briefs from your own systems and turns written notes into tasks, so every meeting ends in action.
- [Data Analyst AI Agent](https://ihtech.ba/ai-agents/data-analyst-ai-agent/): Data Analyst AI Agent answers business questions in plain words from your own data, with the chart and the calculation, so managers stop waiting for reports.
